fullPassage: A classical ideal of truth and knowledge is the concept of a market for ideas: as thinking individuals, we encounter competing ideas, we evaluate them for their best fit to reality, and then let the best and brightest facts form the basis of our beliefs. That would be the scientist's way, in theory at least. But in practice, most of the time we are in a market for justifications. We shop for words not because they contain ideas, but because they contain stories about ideas. Often we are not seeking statements as facts to help us figure out what we should believe. Usually we already know what we believe. What we seek are statements to justify those beliefs — the lawyer's way. Language might be good for this function but we can use it to do better. By treating language with greater respect, we can achieve more than simple self-defense.

❌ ① 과학적 사고 우선: 반대 — 실제로는 정당화
✅ ② 정당화 치중: market for justifications ←정답
❌ ③ 협력: 언급 없음
❌ ④ 유일한 수단: 언급 없음

ch: 과학적 사고는 모든 분야에서 우선시되어야 한다.
사람들은 진실 탐구보다 기존 믿음의 정당화에 더 치중한다.
변호사와 과학자의 협력이 사회 발전에 필수적이다.
언어는 의사소통의 유일한 수단이므로 보호해야 한다.

questions.passage: A classical ideal of truth and knowledge is the concept of a market for ideas: as thinking individuals, we encounter competing ideas, we evaluate them for their best fit to reality, and then let the best and brightest facts form the basis of our beliefs. That would be the scientist's way, in theory at least. But in practice, most of the time we are in a market for justifications. We shop for words not because they contain ideas, but because they contain stories about ideas. Often we are not seeking statements as facts to help us figure out what we should believe. Usually we already know what we believe. What we seek are statements to justify those beliefs — the lawyer's way. Language might be good for this function but we can use it to do better. __________, we can achieve more than simple self-defense.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
"언어를 더 큰 존중으로 대함으로써"
[조건] (1) By, greater, language, respect, treating, with를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: By treating language with greater respect = 언어를 더 큰 존중으로 대함으로써.
det.analysis: By + 동명사(treating): ~함으로써. treat A with B: A를 B로 대하다. greater respect: 더 큰 존중
